metric_semantics.crazygames.rating: Displayed score labeled last six months; scale maximum not explicitly present in observed text. Not a usage metric.
metric_semantics.crazygames.likes: Displayed positive vote count. Detail Votes text or explicitly identified thumbs-up card counter, with source surface preserved. Accumulation window unspecified. K means 1000, M means 1000000; exact count and rounding unknown.
metric_semantics.crazygames.dislikes: Displayed negative vote count; same precision and time-window limits as likes.
metric_semantics.crazygames.plays: Displayed game play count where observed. Sprunki Hot hover card displays 30M beside a play icon within totalPlays DOM class. Accumulation window and unique-player definition unspecified. Other unobserved values remain null; never inferred from votes.
metric_semantics.crazygames.active_users: No game-level active users observed; never inferred from votes.
